groups.name: rect-alpha-one-1x
groups.rationale: Own integer CSS rect R on a fractionally translated owner at opacity 1, without a clip-path. At DPR 1, only the fully covered blue underlay changes. Compare complete equal-scale RGBA images within each renderer; exact equality is a hypothesis, not an assumed Chrome result. Record whether the reference contains intermediate edge colors.
